(33001) 1997 CU
29
(
provisional designation
1997 CU
29
) is a cold
classical Kuiper belt object
, or cubewano. It has a
perihelion
(closest approach to the
Sun
) at 41.6 AU and an
aphelion
(farthest approach from the
Sun
) of 45.1 AU.
1997 CU
29
is about 280 km in diameter. It was discovered on February 6, 1997, by
David C. Jewitt
,
Jane X. Luu
,
Chad Trujillo
, and
Jun Chen
at the
Mauna Kea Observatory
,
Hawaii
.
